desc: Derive and prove the cost formula: min operations for subarray = sum of deficits vs. running prefix maximum (only increments allowed, so raising to running max is optimal).
Design the sliding window: for each right r, add nums[r] to the window cost using a monotonic stack of (value, count) blocks.
Implement left-edge contraction: when cost > k, advance left, adjusting the first block and propagating deficit to the next block when a segment is fully removed.
Implement counting: after shrinking window to cost ≤ k, add (r - l + 1) to the answer for each r.
Verify the implementation against brute force on small random arrays and edge cases (k=0, single element, non-decreasing input, large values); confirm examples yield 17 and 12; fix bugs if any.
Finalize complexity analysis (O(n) amortized time, O(n) space) and deliver clean final code in the starter template with comments.
